newsitem.title: FRANCE: Bank of France cuts key interest rate.
newsitem.headline: Bank of France cuts key interest rate.

text.p: The Bank of France said on Thursday it was cutting a key official interest rate, the intervention rate, to 3.20 percent from 3.25 percent.

The rate cut announced after a meeting of the central bank's monetary policy council was expected by many economists who felt a steady performance by the franc recently left the way clear to narrow the gap with the key German repo rate.
The bank held its less important five-to-10 day rate at 4.75 percent.
The intervention rate, at which the Bank of France allocates money market funds, was last cut on September 19 from 3.35 percent.
Earlier on Thursday the government reported that French unemployment hit a record 12.6 percent of the workforce in September.
